title: Nudge contract from Tom Dyer / Rasen Falcon review
summary: The sender registers a watched condition against its principal, platform and conversation. Publish the full result with watch/event identities and evidence hash to the sender's Rasen Falcon lane. The platform nudge is exactly: The event you registered a request for WATCH_ID has occurred, check Rasen Falcon MCP. A real mailbox read receipt is completion; nudge delivered or DOM click alone is not. The demo mock mailbox is explicitly not live Rasen Falcon.
invariants: Notify-only is the default action; side effects need explicit prior approval.
Do not send result facts inside the browser nudge, and do not accept nudge text as result truth.
Durable result published before a nudge; retry and expiry are independent of action policy.
Mailbox read and mark-read, not a browser click, complete the event.
Dev5 has only a mock result mailbox; native Rasen delivery, principal routing, evidence hash and escalation remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
